description: ČR 2030 8.3.2 Podniky prodávající přes webové stránky, mobilní aplikace nebo online tržiště, podle velikosti podniku is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo životního prostředí. Data set of the Sustainable Development Indicator of the Czech Republic 2030 8.3.2: Businesses selling via websites, mobile apps or online marketplaces. Created from the underlying data of the Czech Statistical Office. Coverage: Ministerstvo životního prostředí. The portal shows the English title as "Czech Republic 2030 8.3.2 Enterprises selling via websites, mobile applications or online marketplaces, depending on the" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo životního prostředí. Its keywords include internet. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00164801/0ee8cde8f20b4dc1a5b3e5c01e9b0b8f/distribuce/a010acad36ed25e71be4dfb4746d7bd1/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
